scope:
Matrix trial (remote L4 only): pipelined INT8 IMMA kernel v2 (cheap issue path) versus swizzle, INT8 v1, pipe v1 and cuBLAS FP8.

Candidate: benchmarks/k5_group_imma_pipe2_cuda.cu (new). Same arithmetic as the
first INT8 kernel (byte-identical outputs expected); the change is the per-thread
chunk descriptors computed once, float group scales prepared once per matrix by
the kernel's own prepare entry (same exp2f arithmetic), and float code sums.
Variants: SUB 32 x 2/3/4/5 stages, SUB 16 x 3/4 stages. Predeclared primary:
SUB 32 x 4 stages (three shapes), SUB 16 x 4 stages (4096x12288).

Controls: preserved swizzle binary f5d15c22..., INT8 v1 binary, pipe v1 binary
(SUB 32 x 4 stages), all hash-checked against their records. Competitor:
torch._scaled_mm E4M3 per-tensor with and without activation quantization.
Same accuracy checks and graph timing as the earlier trials. Nothing existing is
modified.
